name: Home — Kitchen, Dining & Lounge
description: Real smartphone capture of a lived-in home, reconstructed as a Gaussian splat (Nerfstudio splatfacto, 30k iterations).

calibration.note: Radiance-field exports have no absolute scale. 2.34 m/unit is estimated from the dining table top (assumed 0.75 m high); replace with a measured reference or ARCore poses for survey-grade distances.
